item.title: The current postgraduate medical recruitment crisis justifies rapid reform
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, As the BMA Medical Students Committee education lead, I share the author’s view that foundation programme recruitment, and postgraduate medical recruitment in general requires radical reform. item.title: Multifocal Macular Lesions in a Child: A Preventable Case of Laser-Induced Retinopathy
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor We read with interest the recent case describing unilateral vision loss in a child with multifocal macular lesions. This report highlights the often under-recognized risk of laser-induced retinopathy in pediatric populations. item.title: Headache or Ophthalmic Emergency? Rethinking Acute Visual Loss in General Practice

item.title: BMA responds to Palantir's involvement with ICE and questions their increasing centrality in the NHS
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The BMA and members we represent have long opposed the involvement of Palantir in the provision of care in our NHS. During our last Annual Representative Meeting, a resolution to further formalise our opposition was voted through by representatives from all parts of the NHS across the UK. item.title: Paper mills or paper tigers? AI must distinguish linguistic patterns from scientific fraud
